**In one line**: Chinese AI company Zhipu claims its new model is better than Anthropic's and OpenAI's at finding bugs in code.

### Key points
- Zhipu reportedly says its latest model outperforms leading Western labs at spotting bugs in software code.
- The company named Anthropic and OpenAI models as its direct benchmarks.
- Coding and debugging have become a central battleground in the current LLM race.

### Why it matters
It signals that Chinese AI firms are beginning to claim competitiveness against Western frontier models on specific, practical tasks like code bug-finding. That said, this is a vendor's own claim, so it warrants caution until independent benchmarks confirm it.
